-- Fix 74c (G4) after 73c: SAP removed DOWNTIMEHOURS. Absorb the change in L1, keep L2 and the app stable.
-- Observed in build: Time Travel returns the table's current columns, so a dropped column cannot be
-- read back with AT/BEFORE. We therefore keep our own copy of the last good L2 snapshot first.

-- 1. Retain the last good snapshot (the DT is suspended by the guard, so its contents are frozen)
create or replace table {{DEMO_DB}}.L2.DOWNTIME_RETAINED comment = 'G4: last good L2 snapshot kept before absorbing a removed column'
as select * from {{DEMO_DB}}.L2.DT_EQUIPMENT_DOWNTIME;

-- 2. L1 keeps its contract: same column name and type, now null because SAP no longer sends it
create or replace view {{DEMO_DB}}.L1.L1_MAINT_NOTIFICATION
  comment = 'G1 contract view. 74c: DOWNTIMEHOURS removed upstream, absorbed as null'
as select MAINTENANCENOTIFICATION::varchar as NOTIFICATION_ID,
          EQUIPMENT::varchar               as EQUIPMENT_ID,
          NOTIFICATIONTYPE::varchar        as NOTIFICATION_TYPE,
          PRIORITY::varchar                as PRIORITY,
          CREATEDON::date                  as CREATED_ON,
          null::number(10,2)               as DOWNTIME_HOURS,
          'SAP'                            as PROVENANCE
   from {{DEMO_L0}}.MAINTENANCE.MAINT_NOTIFICATION;

-- 3. Serving keeps the retained hours for history; new rows show no hours until SAP provides a replacement
create or replace view {{DEMO_DB}}.SERVING.V_DOWNTIME
  comment = 'What users read. 74c: downtime hours from the retained snapshot where the live value is gone'
as select d.SITE, d.FLEET_TYPE, d.EQUIPMENT_ID, d.EQUIPMENT_NAME, d.MONTH, d.NOTIFICATIONS,
          coalesce(d.DOWNTIME_HOURS, r.DOWNTIME_HOURS) as DOWNTIME_HOURS
   from {{DEMO_DB}}.L2.DT_EQUIPMENT_DOWNTIME d
   left join {{DEMO_DB}}.L2.DOWNTIME_RETAINED r
     on r.EQUIPMENT_ID = d.EQUIPMENT_ID and r.MONTH = d.MONTH;

-- 4. Contract: the column is deprecated, so drift no longer counts it as breaking
update {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.L0_CONTRACT set STATUS = 'DEPRECATED'
where TABLE_NAME = 'MAINT_NOTIFICATION' and COLUMN_NAME = 'DOWNTIMEHOURS';

-- 5. Resume behind the users and refresh now
alter dynamic table {{DEMO_DB}}.L2.DT_EQUIPMENT_DOWNTIME resume;
alter dynamic table {{DEMO_DB}}.L2.DT_EQUIPMENT_DOWNTIME refresh;

insert into {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.SCHEMA_CHANGE_LOG (SCENARIO, EVENT, GUARDRAIL, DETAIL, SOURCE)
values ('74c', 'FIX_APPLIED', 'G4', 'Absorbed in L1 (DOWNTIME_HOURS kept as null), last good snapshot retained for history, contract column DEPRECATED, DT resumed', 'PRESENTER');
